description: This file contains configuration interfaces and classes for setting up memory streams within the Orleans framework, including builder classes for silo and client configurations, methods for partitioning, and related factory integrations.

classes.name: MemoryStreamConfiguratorExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring memory stream partitioning.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator`1
classes.description: Configures memory streams for silos with a specified serializer.

classes.name: ClusterClientMemoryStreamConfigurator`1
classes.description: Configures memory streams for cluster clients with a specified serializer.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of queues for memory streams partitioning.

methods.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor for silo memory stream configurator, sets up service configuration and logging.

methods.name: ClusterClientMemoryStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor for cluster client memory stream configurator, initializes with builder.
